families.entry_deadline: Reuse the learning entry gate and add an entry deadline. Require entry explicitly in the synthetic context. Sweep deadline minus release boundary by -1/0/+1 ms. Add a non-entry control for every conflicting pair.
families.hold_departure: Reuse the learning hold profile. Require x >= 199/200/201 mm at the inclusive endpoint or the next listed sample. All y coordinates are zero; initial coordinates are zero; x is nonnegative. No interpolation or dynamics.
families.speed_progress: Combine a speed cap and minimum distance under the explicit constant-speed relation x_mm = v_mm_s * horizon_s. Sweep the minimum distance by -1/0/+1 mm around cap * horizon.
families.three_way_timing: Combine release >= stop + wait, entry >= release + delay, and entry <= stop + deadline. Sweep deadline by -1/0/+1 ms around wait + delay. Every proper subset must remain SAT.

checks: Evaluate the context alone and every nonempty constraint subset using the unchanged platform Core compiler and Z3.
Compare each result with an independent analytic integer oracle. Record UNKNOWN and mismatches separately; fail completion if either occurs.
Independently validate every SAT witness using numeric source parameters, not the Core expressions.
Enumerate subset-minimal UNSAT constraint groups relative to the fixed context; recheck every one-component deletion.
Require paired exact-boundary SAT controls for every generated contradictory full composition.
Report component-only, pairwise, and full-composition detection separately; do not pool with fault injection or VLM predictions.
claim_scope: All sources, observations, deadlines, and progress obligations are supplied synthetic inputs, not extracted road rules or accident reconstructions.
SAT/UNSAT concerns simultaneous satisfiability under the declared context. An UNSAT source group diagnoses conflicting requirements, not which source is wrong.
The preserved no-entry controls demonstrate that progress obligations must be explicit; waiting may satisfy a combination when entry is optional.
This is a post-training logical composition diagnostic; no CNL parser, model training, actual driving safety, or preservation of legal exceptions is evaluated.
Cases are an exhaustive fixed parameter grid, not independent road scenes or a population estimate.
